title: Record a Run
gpsBanner: Tracked by GPS — distance, time and elevation are filled in. Add a type and notes, then save.
indoorBanner: Indoor session recorded. Duration and heart rate are filled in; there is no distance to record. Add notes, then save.
watchBanner: Imported from your watch — check the details (there's no route/map), pick a type, then save.

import.title: Import an activity file
import.gpx: <0>FIT / GPX / TCX:</0> one activity with its route map, elevation and heart rate
import.perActivity: <0>Get one run from Strava:</0> on strava.com open the activity, then ••• → Export Original (the .fit file) or Export GPX, and import the file here
import.zepp: <0>Zepp CSV:</0> Profile → Privacy Center → Export Personal Data
import.strava: <0>Strava CSV:</0> Settings → My Account → Download or Delete → Request Archive
import.noRuns: No runs found in that file.
import.alreadyImported_one: Already imported — that run is in your log.
import.alreadyImported_other: Already imported — those runs are in your log.
